invariants.name: draw_calls_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: A painted dense-UI frame must issue at least one real draw. Missing stays not-evaluable.

invariants.name: gpu_upload_bytes_observed_on_encode
invariants.note: Count only after a host encodes/submits. Missing stays not-evaluable and must never be treated as 0.

notes: NanaUI-internal draw-call scale row; not Issue #8 DoD and has no Iced/GPUI analog. Ordinary UI only, one GPU content slot. Rows emit Quad/Text/Icon in document order, and adjacent-run merging cannot cross them, so this measures the framework's per-node draw-call floor. This is the row that decides whether overlap-aware batch merging is worth building.
